title: Yellow Sunny Turkish Corn Pilaf
description: A tangy and light Turkish dish featuring white cornmeal, perfect for a weeknight dinner, made using sous-vide for consistent results and is nut-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, water, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lemon juice and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a sous-vide bag and seal the bag, making sure to remove as much air as possible.
Place the bag in the preheated sous-vide machine and cook for 30 minutes.
Remove the bag from the machine and carefully cut it open, pouring the pilaf into a serving dish.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Let the pilaf cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
